newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 13.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
* Former IMF economist Yves-Marie Koissy named as head of Ivory Coast's cocoa and coffee Caistab marketing board
* new heads for state forest development board SODEFOR and of the state agricultural mechanisation company MOTORAGRI.
* Government launches project to boost non-traditional farm exports and create more than 1,000 new jobs
* Ivory Coast names its first women ambassadors
* Government, which is already cracking down on violent crime, unveils plan to solve problem of street children

- Students union FESCI writes to President Bedie accusing the education minister of planning to cut grants, complaining about new rules governing grants and saying student unrest possible - Former security minister Gaston Ouassenan Kone nominated to board of state forest development board SODEFOR.
- Economy and Finance Minister N'Goran Niamien announces government liberalisation of gasoline prices and withdrawal of subsidies on certain petroleum products.
